trial_title: Valproic Acid in Childhood Progressive Brain Tumors
brief_summary: The study investigates valproic acid added to radiation and temozolomide therapy (standard of care) for progressive or recurrent pediatric brain tumors.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject, parent, or guardian willing and able to give informed consent
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is an adult but can still provide informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Recurrent or progressive pediatric brain tumor, with MRI evidence of disease
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has anaplastic astrocytoma of the spine, which is not classified as a pediatric brain tumor.

eligibility_table.criterion: Age at first diagnosis of brain tumor 1-21 years old
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 45 years old, which exceeds the age limit of 1-21 years at first diagnosis.

eligibility_table.criterion: Lansky or Karnofsky performance score of at least 50 at diagnosis
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's performance status is not provided, but given the severe symptoms and treatments, it is likely below the required score.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently pregnant or has the patient been pregnant within the last 12 months?
Has the patient experienced any adverse reactions or intolerances to valproic acid in previous treatments?
Has the patient received temozolomide for a total of ≥6 cycles prior to enrollment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Use of enzyme inducing anticonvulsant medications (see appendix B)
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been prescribed any enzyme-inducing anticonvulsant medications during their treatment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Known urea cycle disorder (e.g. ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency)
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented diagnosis of a urea cycle disorder, specifically ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency?

attention_flags: EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Prior intolerance to valproic acid
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: History of use of temozolomide
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Use of enzyme inducing anticonvulsant medications (see appendix B)
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Known urea cycle disorder (e.g. ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency)
LOW INCLUSION MATCH: only 1 of 4 inclusion criteria met
